_comment: Active D18/F09 evidence: one recorded player-projectile launch, one Thud-overlay action-20 contact-object launch and controlled native grain-pickup effect plus one causally isolated textured billboard presentation and one exact negative-cue SPU key-on sequence, one causal six-row rolling-boulder contact, eight pristine Thud contact-damage/overlay-reset cycles, the counter-8 actor-target path, defeat, retirement and scene exit. General audio mapping, other boss attacks, full arena ownership/completion and the complete hit curve remain open.

fixture_census.inventory_scope: Selected after recursively enumerating movies/Phase4 and the broader operator movie tree; the existing relevant recording was preferred.

movie.recorded_input_scope: all 16 digital buttons; no analog axes

fixture_census.classification_boundary: The filename and JSON serial are leads only. Pre-load save inspection, mounted pristine CUE/BIN hashes, typed actor state and natural replay carry the authority claim.

static_census.runtime_identity_rule: Region-A addresses are scene/save-owned. Exact runtime bytes must be captured and may not be labeled LEVEL08/LEVEL*.BIN unless hashes match.

disassembly_validation.retention_boundary: The full original-game instruction capture is validated in memory but not retained; only decisive transfers and hash metadata are committed.
The full original-game continuation is validated in memory but not retained; only exact hash metadata and control transfers are committed.
The full save-owned instruction block is validated in memory but not retained; only exact hash metadata and control transfers are committed.

launch_writer_attribution.execution_mode_boundary: accessLog/execTrace force the interpreter. The exact allocation and caller are source attribution only; passive and matched movie branches carry behavior.
launch_writer_attribution.selector_boundary: The allocation and resident caller are exact. This campaign does not assign a berry color from the sampled selector byte.

launch_input_counterfactual.control_rule: Both branches activate in-memory descendants of the same pinned movie and are full-RAM/register/cycle equal at target 896. Only Square is cleared for source frames 896..917; no derivative movie bytes are retained.
launch_input_counterfactual.falsified_alternative: The action-2 allocation, subsequent -2 contact and first reset are not invariant to the recorded Square input window.

post_restore_attack_attribution.execution_mode_boundary: accessLog/execTrace force the interpreter. Exact caller and allocator writes are source attribution only; passive boundaries and a separate matched one-field branch carry behavior.
post_restore_attack_attribution.effect_boundary: The caller and action-20 allocation are exact. This evidence does not alone assign a presentation, hit, damage amount, target, or completion effect; the separate matched visual control binds one textured-billboard presentation.

post_restore_attack_control.control_rule: Each side reloads target 970 from the same pinned pristine movie/state with full RAM/register/cycle equality before the one write. Both advance through movie target 971. The changed branch path ends one CPU cycle earlier and is intentionally not presented as equal-cycle timing evidence.
post_restore_attack_control.causal_confirmation: Changing only the derived countdown from 9 to zero prevents the natural slot-17 action-20/TTL-200/class-128 allocation.

action20_sound_attribution.execution_mode_boundary: execTrace forces the interpreter. This replay attributes the exact caller and arguments only; the separate matched SPU branch carries causal behavior and neither branch is used as passive timing proof.
action20_sound_attribution.bounded_interpretation: This is one negative play_sound cue with the Thud position pointer. It is not a positive sfx_dispatch id, named asset, waveform, host-speaker drain or general E12 audio mapping.

action20_sound_control.control_rule: Both sides reload target 970 from the same pinned pristine state with full RAM/register/cycle equality. The mutation replaces only the save-owned jal at 0x800B3FFC with one NOP and invalidates its code page. SPU tracing is re-armed after each load; both branches advance to target 980 and preserve the same action-20 record and gameplay state. The NOP path ends one guest cycle later at the same separately retained exact PC.
action20_sound_control.causal_confirmation: Suppressing only the exact -14 play_sound call removes six bounded SPU events, including four pre-shared-frame key-ons whose sample start address is 0x00009E10, without removing or changing the action-20 launch object.
action20_sound_control.forbidden_claim: The emulated key-on sequence does not name an asset, retain audio bytes, prove a waveform, prove host-speaker drain, bind natural-hit frequency, or complete the general E12 audio campaign.

action20_effect_attribution.execution_mode_boundary: accessLog/execTrace force the interpreter. These exact writes and registers are source/effect attribution only; passive boundaries and the separate matched branch carry natural and causal behavior.
action20_effect_attribution.bounded_effect: The native action-20 player-proximity path calls resident handler 0x80054EAC, increments grain, records state 16, sets the active gate to 1 and calls bookkeeping with result -1. This path does not itself bind presentation; a separate matched control binds one textured billboard. Sound, damage amount, natural-hit frequency and completion remain open.

action20_effect_control.control_rule: Each side reloads target 972 from the same centrally pinned pristine movie/state with full RAM/register/cycle equality. The only mutation is the two-byte signed radius_add field; both sides then advance through deterministic movie target 972 and stop at the same frame and cycle at the same retained exact PC.
action20_effect_control.causal_confirmation: Changing only radius_add from 100 to 6000 makes the existing action-20 record pass the resident player-proximity gate. Native handling increments grain 0->1, stores record state 16 and sets the active gate to 1 without changing player health.

action20_visual_presentation_control.control_rule: Both sides reload target 970 from the same pinned pristine movie/state with full RAM/register/cycle equality. The only write sets the derived countdown 9->0, suppressing the source allocation. Both sides then stop at the same movie/emulator frame and SP before an in-memory framebuffer diff. The suppressed path ends on the same cycle at a separately retained exact PC. No image bytes are written or retained.

notes: ramAddress/dmaSource/vertexPointer are exact; orderingTableEntry is the probable linked-list header immediately before the GP0 packet.
Texture transparency was checked against the current texture-page/CLUT contents.
The live GTE SXY/SZ FIFOs did not exactly match this packet, so gteVertices is empty.

natural_object_pick.retention_boundary: Raw GP0 words and any framebuffer bytes are not retained; typed draw geometry, texture metadata and RAM provenance are sufficient.

action20_visual_presentation_control.causal_confirmation: Suppressing only the source countdown removes one 593-pixel 28x35 framebuffer region. The natural pixels belong to a textured quad whose exact DMA source is 0x001CF3D4.

action20_renderer_attribution.execution_mode_boundary: accessLog forces the interpreter. These reads and packet writes attribute source only; the matched cached-interpreter framebuffer control carries visual behavior and exact timing.
action20_renderer_attribution.attribution: The pristine renderer reads slot 17's active gate, flags, XYZ, sizes, action 20, subtype, mode and command/color word. In the same render tick it writes the picked quad beginning at exact DMA source 0x001CF3D4 through resident PCs 0x80014A30..0x80014A6C.

transient_writer_attribution.execution_mode_boundary: accessLog/execTrace force the interpreter. These rows attribute writers and ownership only; passive trace pairs carry timing.
transient_writer_attribution.ownership_boundary: 0x8005905C is an inner class-dispatch block inside the resident 0x80058AF8 contact-vs-actor handler, not a standalone call entry. 0x80054A64 calls the save-owned overlay update at 0x800B3C70.

arena_damage_attribution.execution_mode_boundary: accessLog and execTrace force the interpreter. The six-row call chain and exact health writer are attribution only; passive traceToFrame boundaries and a separate matched threshold control carry behavior and timing.
arena_damage_attribution.bounded_join: The save-owned loop transforms six object rows, calls the resident candidate builder for each, and compares player distance against a per-row squared threshold. Only row 4 passes; with player +0x92 zero, 0x800B4AE0 calls the resident level-transition/damage initiator with a3=0, and 0x8004A888 stores health 3->2.

arena_damage_control.control_rule: Each side reloads target 1466 from the same pinned pristine movie/state. Full RAM, registers, cycle, frame, PC and SP match before the only write; both sides advance through deterministic movie target 1471.
arena_damage_control.causal_confirmation: Changing only row 4's squared-distance threshold from 490000 to zero prevents health 3->2 while player position, frame, PC and SP remain equal; the threshold-zero branch ends on the same cycle.

phase_branch_attribution.execution_mode_boundary: Point execTrace watches force the interpreter. These two three-frame windows attribute branch operands only; passive traceToFrame pairs carry natural frame/cycle behavior.

damage_class.falsified_alternative: The 50->48 decrement is not invariant to the contact damage-class byte.

overlay_target_hp.falsified_alternative: The 48->50 restoration is not independent of 0x800B4C70.

phase_reset_guards.interpretation: Exact target/HP equality and signed HP<21 suppress the restore; only an exact arena sentinel increments the counter; counter 8 enters master state 1; grain 41 changes the same-frame derived value from 9 to 8.

master_timer_gate.interpretation: With the same timer-zero setup, master state 0 integrates the scene-14 reset path while master state 1 blocks it.

causal_controls.control_rule: Each side reloads the same pristine movie/state boundary; only the named field differs before an equal emulator.advanceFrames step. The master-state pair additionally applies the same timer-zero setup to both sides before its named mutation.

trajectory_writer_attribution.execution_mode_boundary: accessLog forces the interpreter. These windows attribute exact writers/readers only; passive boundaries and the matched one-field control carry behavior and timing.
trajectory_writer_attribution.proved_join: The overlay decrements 0x800B4CB0 by 2560, copies the result to actor +0x28/+0x34, and resident actor motion reads those targets.

trajectory_control.interpretation: A +4096 path-coordinate mutation produces exact +4096 actor X/Z motion targets and +4096 final actor X while player position, actor Y/Z, heading and timer stay fixed. Both branches still retire at the sampled boundary, so completion policy is not assigned.
trajectory_control.control_rule: Each side reloads target 3741 from the same pristine movie/state. Full RAM, registers, cycle, frame, PC and SP match before the only write; both sides then advance equal emulator-frame counts.

writer_attribution.execution_mode_boundary: accessLog forces the interpreter. Its instruction/value rows are writer attribution only; behavior/timing comes from separate passive cycle-neutral traceToFrame replays.
writer_attribution.scene_watch_boundary: No scene event is required: the scene transition resets/unloads instrumentation. Passive frame 4039 is the scene-exit authority.

bounded_interpretation.observation: Recorded Square input precedes a slot-26 action-2 allocation and the first contact. Eight actor-id-36 HP 50->48->50 cycles advance the phase counter 0->8 and alternate exact signed path sentinels. Separately, one six-row save-owned transform loop places an object close enough to the player to call the resident transition/damage initiator and lower health 3->2; transient visual context shows a rolling-boulder overlap. The eighth restore enters master state 1. After the first restore, the same actor-owned overlay naturally allocates slot 17 as action 20, TTL 200 and class 128. Its natural trajectory keeps grain at zero and retires without collection. At target 980 the natural frame contains one small textured quad that is absent when the source allocation is suppressed. The same launch calls play_sound with cue -14 and the actor-position pointer; its bounded SPU window contains four early key-ons at sample start 0x00009E10. The counter-8 path coordinate then decrements by 2560 per update and is copied to actor X/Z motion targets. Later HP reaches 0, the active bit/live-table slot clear, and scene 14 exits.
bounded_interpretation.inference: Scene graph and actor identity bind this lifecycle to Thud in Stage 9 Bug Bar. Resident caller 0x8004724C classifies the observed action-2 allocation as a player throw without assigning a berry color from the sampled selector. The save-owned caller 0x800B3FF0 and actor register bind the separate action-20 contact-object launch to Thud. Static pristine dispatch bytes and live registers bind its controlled contact to the resident player-proximity walker and grain handler. The pristine 0x80014844 renderer and exact RAM packet source bind its observed presentation as a contact-record textured billboard. The save-owned 0x800B3FFC caller and pristine resident play_sound slice bind its separate negative-cue request.
bounded_interpretation.causal_confirmation: The Square-cleared branch suppresses the allocation, damage and first reset. Writer traces bind 50->48 to 0x800590E4 and 48->50 to 0x800B3ED0. Equal-frame one-field controls change class 0->127 and HP 48->46, target 50->49 and restored HP 50->49, and bind the target-equality, signed HP floor, exact arena sentinel, counter-8, grain threshold and master/timer guards. Point traces capture matching branch operands; passive coverage independently contains the writers at fixed frames. Zeroing only the winning arena row's squared-distance threshold prevents health 3->2 at an equal-cycle/position endpoint. A +4096 path-coordinate control yields exact +4096 actor X/Z targets and final actor X. Zeroing only the derived countdown at target 970 suppresses the natural action-20 allocation at target 971. Enlarging only slot 17 radius_add from 100 to 6000 at target 972 makes the native action-20 branch increment grain 0->1, store state 16 and set its active gate to 1 at the next frame; the matched control keeps grain 0, state 24 and decrements 200->199. A separate matched countdown branch removes exactly 593 pixels in one 28x35 framebuffer box; object picking and complete interpreter attribution join that natural quad to slot 17 and its resident packet writer. NOPing only 0x800B3FFC preserves the action-20 record and gameplay endpoint while reducing the bounded SPU page 13->7 and removing four early 0x00009E10 key-ons.
bounded_interpretation.forbidden_claim: Do not infer a berry color, action-20 damage effect, named sound asset, waveform, host-speaker drain, texture/model identity beyond the measured billboard, natural hit frequency, a monotonic HP curve, complete attack policy, complete rolling-arena geometry/ownership/completion, unsampled continuation paths, or D18/F09 completion.

bounded_open_frontier.attacks_phases: One player-thrown projectile source/launch and one Thud-owned action-20 contact-object source/launch, natural miss/retirement controlled player-proximity grain-pickup path and one causal textured-billboard presentation are bound. Its negative -14 play_sound request and one bounded 0x00009E10 SPU key-on sequence are also causal. Named sound-asset/waveform identity, host drain, natural-hit frequency, other variants and complete attack policy remain open.
bounded_open_frontier.arena: One six-row save-owned object-transform/collision branch and row-4 damage threshold are causal for a visible rolling-boulder overlap. Counter 8 naturally enters master state 1 with heading 32 and motion timer 149. The boss path coordinate and actor-motion trajectory are separately causal; complete geometry, ownership, phase linkage and completion remain open.
bounded_open_frontier.damage_curve: Eight natural action-2/class-0 contacts give -2 and class 127 gives -4 under intervention. Full berry-power/HP curves remain open.
bounded_open_frontier.reset_policy: The exact 612-byte save-owned reset-owner front half and its equality/floor/sentinel/counter/grain/master guards are bound. The next exact 308-byte continuation slice and one natural allocator branch are bound; other continuation paths remain open.
bounded_open_frontier.lifecycle: Initialization, re-engagement, retry/checkpoint and persistence breadth remain open; only natural defeat/retirement/exit is bound.
bounded_open_frontier.next_experiment: Bind another attack or continue from the causal rolling-boulder row to full geometry, phase linkage and completion without relabeling the actor path; leave broader audio identity and lifecycle to E12.
